statement.to_be_said_elsewhere: PROPOSED LEVEL · 12.7 M · VYSHNEVSKYI & SHEVCHUK 2024 · THE TREES DEAD AND STANDING, THE WATER ROUND THEM AND THE BED'S HEIGHTS DRAWN OR INFERRED · DRAWN; and that the view under the water, its silt, the dead trees and the water's disturbance round them are drawn.

said_so: SPECULATIVE AND DRAWN: the water at the proposed level, its ripples and murk, the view from under the surface, the plants' dead state, and now the water round the stems that pierce the surface (meniscus, foam collar, wake). Nothing is observed and nothing is generated by an AI tool.

The disturbance is placed where the plants' own modelled stems cross the proposed level (crossings_v10.py); its sizes scale with each stem's radius; the current's direction is v7's drawn current (toward the south-west) and its speed the drawn ripples' (0.3 m/s): neither is measured.
The birds of v9 are gone (the user).
The level is a proposal: 12.7 m Baltic (Vyshnevskyi & Shevchuk 2024, p. 286), 13.1 m in the scene. The bed's heights are inferred (scene3d/bed.py).
The sound is v9's, unchanged (copied): the synthesized line, muffled under water (drawn).

fix_stray_branches.what: the pieces floating in the sky at v9's top left (about x 0-260, y 160-240 at 1080p, left of the near willow) were secondary branches of the near willows kept while the primary branch they grow from was dropped: v8 ranks a model's stems by radius with a 15% random share mixed in, so a thick secondary could outrank its primary
fix_stray_branches.how: still_v10.py finds each stem's parent from the models' geometry (a branch's first point lies on its parent's centre line) and caps its order by the parent's: a stem shows only while the stem it grows from shows. The random draws are v8's, so nothing attached changes.
